summary:
Iteration 18 verifies the NEW payment-screenshot -> auto-UTR feature end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases PASSED on POST /api/ai/extract-utr (auth, positive extraction, no-UTR fallback, empty-file rejection). Frontend: Playwright drove register -> draft -> /app/pay -> single-scan manual UPI -> ready-to-pay -> payment-done -> proof-screen -> screenshot upload; the label switched to 'Reading UTR from screenshot…' with a spinner, then Gemini returned found=true and the UI auto-filled utr-full-input with '401234567890', showed '12/12 digits' and the success toast 'UTR auto-filled from screenshot ✓'. Regression: the 11-digit UTR still surfaces the 'UTR number must be exactly 12 digits' toast, and single-scan still lands directly on ready-to-pay (no second scan).

Backend contract verified against public URL https://invoice-locked.preview.emergentagent.com/api:
- Without token -> HTTP 401.
- With a fabricated/on-disk UPI screenshot containing a printed 12-digit reference -> HTTP 200 {utr:'<12 digits>', found:true}, elapsed ~41s (well inside the 40s asyncio.wait_for + gateway 60s window, no 5xx).
- With a blank/no-ref image -> HTTP 200 {utr:'', found:false}.
- With empty file body -> HTTP 400 'Empty file'.
- Endpoint never returned 5xx across the whole run (Gemini did NOT hit 503 during this iteration).

Frontend UI verified in Playwright:
- data-testid 'screenshot-label' initial text = 'Upload payment screenshot to auto-read UTR'.
- After selecting /tmp/upi_shot.png on data-testid 'screenshot-input', label transitioned to 'Reading UTR from screenshot…' with the Loader2 spinner, then reverted to the filename once resolved.
- utr-full-input value auto-populated with '401234567890'; utr-digit-count read '12/12 digits'; success toast 'UTR auto-filled from screenshot ✓' rendered.
- Regression: typing '12345678901' (11 digits) and clicking submit-proof-btn raised the 'UTR number must be exactly 12 digits' toast.
- Regression: manual UPI entry 'merchant@okaxis' lands DIRECTLY on data-testid 'ready-to-pay' (no second-scan step).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/ai.py extract_utr: image size cap is checked BEFORE PIL downscale, so an 8MB screenshot is still read into memory first (fine). Consider streaming/limit at UploadFile boundary if abuse becomes a concern.

extract_utr swallows ALL exceptions into found=false (line 242). This is intentional per spec (never 5xx to client) but currently loses the distinction between a Gemini rate-limit (429) and a genuine parse error. Consider logging the exception class + status so ops can tell 503-storms apart from real bugs (logger.exception is already there — good).

PayNow.jsx onScreenshot() sets 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' manually; axios normally sets the boundary automatically. Works here because axios overwrites it when a FormData is passed, but the explicit header is redundant and error-prone if the api wrapper is ever swapped for fetch.
PayNow.jsx line 174 still references the now-unreachable 'second_qr_required' state — harmless dead branch (already flagged in iter17).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for the auto-UTR feature is /app/backend/tests/test_iter18_utr_extract.py (4 tests). Combined with iter16 (deploy/auth/expenses/reports/payments-config) and iter17 (single-scan + 12-digit UTR), the manual UPI + AI-UTR flow is fully covered. IMPORTANT: LIVE Razorpay keys remain — DO NOT invoke /api/manual-pay/{tid}/fee-order + real checkout; keep merchant_amount <=₹25 so the ₹50 wallet bonus absorbs the 10% fee. Gemini extract-utr call takes ~35-45s under normal load; the endpoint is bounded to 40s and degrades to found=false on TimeoutError/Exception — treat a transient found=false as expected, only flag it if OUR endpoint returns 5xx. The test asset used is /tmp/upi_shot.png (also duplicated into frontend/public/upi_shot.png). Frontend fills fd.append('file', file) which matches the backend's expected multipart field name.
